en: A sepia-toned postcard showing extensive ruins spread across a field, likely the remains of buildings destroyed in war. Crumbled stone walls and arches dominate the foreground, with scattered standing pillars or gravestones. In the background stands a largely intact church or similar religious building with a tower. The landscape around is flat and rural. Printed text appears in the upper left corner, and another small text mark is in the lower right.
